name: Men's flight cap, NCO / cadet (plain blue)
size_basis: Measured from CAPR 39-1 Attachment 5 "FLIGHT CAPS" figure (3 March 2020, p.139) at 66.3 px/in, from the figure's own 1 1/2 in marks. Cap body 11.52 x 3.56 in plus 0.12 in margin. The regulation gives no cap dimensions; real caps vary by size.

attach_overlap.assumption: The regulation and Attachment 5 give no relation between the flight cap and the collar (a side view of a cap, no coat). The engine puts garment_attach_center on the garment bounding-box top_center, and the drawn collar does not start there: rendering garment-blues-class-a-coat with this cap, the collar top at the centre line (and 0.5 in either side) is 0.50 in below top_center. OVL = 0.50 in measured collar offset + 0.05 in so the lower edge of the cap lands on the collar with no white gap. The cap outline bottom at the centre line is measured from the figure; only the overlap (the cap-to-collar seating, which the regulation does not give) is estimated.

hat_attach_note: garment_attach_center is at the cap outline's own bottom at the centre line (3.68 in from the top of the asset) minus 0.55 in; the engine puts it on the garment's top_center, so at the centre line the cap's lower edge lands 0.55 in below the garment top, over the collar line. The overlap is estimated (see attach_overlap)
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal 1 in box centred on the device position
orientation: side view, front of cap at left (wearer facing left), wearer's left flap shown
documented: flight cap device on the front left flap, centred halfway between top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.1-3)
Senior member NCOs, cadet officers, cadet NCOs and airmen (6.2.2.2.6, Attachment 5)
general officers silver braid; other officers silver and blue braid; NCOs and cadets plain blue (6.2.2.2.4-6)
worn slightly to the wearer's right, about one inch above the eyebrows (6.2.2.1)
assumed: braid band width and position (about 0.33 of cap height below the top edge, read off the figure)
navy colour sampled from the figure
figure caps differ slightly in height, each variant keeps its own measured outline

fit.method: measured per-row extents of the regulation figure
